risk_description: Apparent positive cash is presented as movable without validation
early_warning_indicator: Single liquidity number lacks restriction/buffer labels
mitigation: Separate ledger available apparent and validated; require local/legal sign-off
contingency: Shift Wave 1 toward visibility and validation

risk_description: Manual effort is converted directly into headcount savings
early_warning_indicator: Business case labels all repair hours cashable
mitigation: Separate capacity from P&L; time sample; protect required controls

risk_description: External case studies predetermine the ACG solution
early_warning_indicator: Option language mirrors a named client/product
mitigation: Use cases only for questions; score three genuine ACG options

risk_description: Local regulatory tax or settlement constraints are discovered late
mitigation: Country/entity constraint matrix and regional review

risk_description: Centralization concentrates access or operational failure
mitigation: Control inventory failure tests rollback and local emergency rights

early_warning_indicator: Pilot overlaps Q4 or lacks SLA/rollback
mitigation: Pilot outside peak; define critical-flow protection and stage gates

risk_description: Three-ERP complexity and legacy retirement create rework
early_warning_indicator: Design assumes uniform integration or invests deeply in retiring ERP
mitigation: Staged interfaces and architecture review; align with retirement plan

risk_description: Six-month dataset hides seasonality or exceptional events
early_warning_indicator: Results vary materially by month or stakeholders dispute period
mitigation: Request longer history and run monthly sensitivity
contingency: Label period limitation and avoid annualization

risk_description: Actual fees borrowing rates and implementation costs are unavailable
early_warning_indicator: Business case uses estimates without owner
mitigation: Obtain invoices/facility data and owner validation; use ranges
contingency: Present validation case rather than committed benefit

risk_description: Source links or claims become stale or are overstated
early_warning_indicator: Live source differs from logged claim
mitigation: Retain access date methodology and limitations; reverify before final
